import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import root, least_squares
N=150000; k=7; s=N-k

def make(x):
    t,q=x
    e=np.exp(t)
    r=np.full(k, 1.0/(e+(k-1)))
    r[0]=e/(e+(k-1))
    main=(1-s*q)*r
    p=np.empty(N)
    p[:k]=main
    p[k:]=q
    return p

def f(x):
    p=make(x)
    logN=np.log(N)
    klf=np.sum(p*np.log(p))+logN
    klb=-logN-np.mean(np.log(p))
    return np.array([klf-10, klb-10])

for t0 in [0.1,0.2,0.3,0.5,1.0]:
    q0=np.exp(-(np.log(N)+10))
    sol=root(f,[t0,q0],method='hybr')
    print(t0, sol.success, sol.x, f(sol.x), np.sum(make(sol.x)))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Construct a distribution over 150,000 tokens with both KL divergences equal to 10."""

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import root

N = 150_000
K = 7  # size of the high-probability part of the support
S = N - K

def distribution(params: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Build the distribution from the main-token logit offset and background mass."""
    t, q = params

    # K-1 equally likely main tokens and one main token with relative weight e**t.
    e = np.exp(t)
    denom = e + (K - 1)
    r = np.full(K, 1.0 / denom)
    r[0] = e / denom

    p = np.empty(N, dtype=np.float64)
    p[:K] = (1.0 - S * q) * r
    p[K:] = q
    return p

def kl_errors(params: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    p = distribution(params)
    log_n = np.log(N)

    # KL(P || U) = log(N) + sum(p * log(p))
    kl_forward = log_n + np.sum(p * np.log(p))

    # KL(U || P) = -log(N) - mean(log(p))
    kl_backward = -log_n - np.mean(np.log(p))

    return np.array([kl_forward - 10.0, kl_backward - 10.0])

def main() -> None:
    # The background probability is close to exp(-(log N + 10)).
    initial_guess = np.array([0.6, np.exp(-(np.log(N) + 10.0))])
    result = root(kl_errors, initial_guess, method="hybr", tol=1e-12)

    if not result.success:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Solver failed: {result.message}")

    p = distribution(result.x)

    # Validate the requested properties.
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(p)) or np.any(p <= 0.0):
        raise RuntimeError("Distribution contains invalid probabilities")
    if not np.isclose(p.sum(), 1.0, atol=1e-12):
        raise RuntimeError(f"Probabilities sum to {p.sum()!r}")

    log_n = np.log(N)
    kl_forward = log_n + np.sum(p * np.log(p))
    kl_backward = -log_n - np.mean(np.log(p))

    if abs(kl_forward - 10.0) > 1e-3 or abs(kl_backward - 10.0) > 1e-3:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"KL targets not met: forward={kl_forward!r}, backward={kl_backward!r}"
        )

    np.save("/app/dist.npy", p)
    print(f"Saved /app/dist.npy")
    print(f"sum                 = {p.sum():.17g}")
    print(f"KL(P || U)          = {kl_forward:.17g}")
    print(f"KL(U || P)          = {kl_backward:.17g}")
    print(f"min / max           = {p.min():.6e} / {p.max():.6e}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
PY
